svg.title: Three ways to compute exp
svg.desc: StrictMath.exp gives fdlibm's bits on every CPU, one double per call. VectorOperators.EXP works on a vector and promises an accuracy bound, not StrictMath's bits; its speed is not measured here. VFdlibm.exp works on a vector and gives StrictMath's bits in every lane.
